description: A prompt with a profile `provider: "scripted:override-model"` override, scripted to fail (`unauthorized`) so the run falls back to its own default `scripted`/`m1`; a `json` tool (`mode: stringify`, `input: "abc"`) with a profile `provider: hash` override. Proves `fallback_attempts[0]`'s own adapter and model (the override, inserted ahead of the primary attempt, and never retried past its one failure), that `meta.adapter`/`meta.model` stay the run's own default once the override attempt fails and the fallback succeeds (settled question 10), and the tool's own `meta.provider` plus its hash value.
